verdict.rationale: The CRA's own pages say Business Registration Online is "the fastest and easiest way" to get a BN. One online form also covers GST/HST, payroll and corporation income tax accounts, and its e-services pages offer online filing of returns and payments. That covers the register, file and pay transactions end to end. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that a founder can complete these transactions fully online.
